editorial:
Imagine you think you are the smartest guy in the room, but you are actually just digging a hole for yourself. That is exactly what happens to the main character in this flick. You follow a young shoe salesman who believes he has a magic touch with money and betting. He thinks he can outsmart the system, but instead, he ends up owing a mountain of cash to some very scary loan sharks. The vibe is a mix of stress and dark humor, as you watch him scramble to fix his life while people are trying to break his legs. It feels like a wild ride where everything that can go wrong does go wrong.

The acting is great because the lead feels like a real person you might know who talks too much. The action scenes are punchy and the pacing keeps you on your toes. While some parts of the plot feel a bit predictable, the tension makes it work. If you like stories about people getting in over their heads, you will love this. You can grab it for a rent on Apple TV or just add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality possible.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the salesman tries one last huge gamble to pay off his debts. He almost pulls it off, but a final betrayal by a supposed friend leaves him broke again. However, he finds a clever way to trick the loan sharks using their own greed against them. He manages to escape with his life, though he loses everything he owned, finally learning that he is not as sharp as he thought.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime stories and underdog characters.
